scope: logo and cover for india-batch-3 content migrations (0108 onward)
rules: This manifest permits neither direct database writes nor automatic Cloudinary uploads.
Every sourceUrl is a direct image URL verified HTTP 200 with an image/* content-type on 2026-09-21; re-verify before upload.
Only a verified Cloudinary URL may be applied to the catalogue; hold entries are excluded.

entries.universityName: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani

assets.rightsBasis: Official BITS Pilani logo served from the university's own domain and declared as the organisation logo (ImageObject, 290x96) in the bits-pilani.ac.in JSON-LD. No open licence - used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-09-21: HTTP 200, content-type image/png, 19,277 bytes, 290x96 px RGBA. Visually confirmed on a white tile: full-colour BITS seal (blue/red/yellow) with navy 'BITS Pilani' wordmark and 'Pilani | Dubai | Goa | Hyderabad | Mumbai' strapline - legible. Small (290 px wide); the header variants bits-pillani-white-2.webp (white-on-transparent, rejected) and bits-pillani-2-1.webp (IoE lockup) were not preferred.

Wikimedia Commons 'File:BITS Pilani.jpg' by Gorlapraveen123, own work, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution and share-alike required: credit 'Gorlapraveen123 / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0'). Original 8160x6144 camera photo dated 13 August 2022 (EXIF). Direct 1920px rendition checked 2026-09-21 with a descriptive User-Agent: HTTP 200, content-type image/jpeg, 1920x1446. Visually confirmed: Pilani campus clock tower and main building with flag line and approach road under a cloudy sky, no text overlays other than a small roadside sign. Alternatives reviewed: 'Bits Clock tower.jpg' (1280x850, professional-looking 'own work' upload - not used because of provenance doubt) and 'BITS Clocktower.jpg' (CC BY-SA 3.0, hazy).
assets.altText: Clock tower and main building of the BITS Pilani campus in Pilani, Rajasthan, with flags lining the approach road

assets.rightsBasis: Official University of Hyderabad header logo served from the university's own domain (img#logo on https://uohyd.ac.in/). No open licence - used as the institution's own brand mark for identification only. HTTP 200, content-type image/png, 1550x360 px RGBA, checked 2026-09-21. Visual confirmation on a white tile: maroon circular seal plus Telugu, Hindi and English 'University of Hyderabad' wordmark - fully legible on white. Square seal-only alternative (300x302, same colour): https://oia.uohyd.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/University_of_Hyderabad_Logo.png.

Wikimedia Commons file 'University Of Hyderabad.jpg' by Y Sai Kumar (own work), licensed CC BY 4.0 - attribution required: 'Photo: Y Sai Kumar, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons'. File page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:University_Of_Hyderabad.jpg. HTTP 200, content-type image/jpeg, 4000x3000 px, checked 2026-09-21 (fetched with a descriptive User-Agent). Visual confirmation: trilingual 'University of Hyderabad' entrance sign with palms and the national flag on the Gachibowli campus, no overlays.
assets.altText: Trilingual University of Hyderabad sign among palm trees, with the Indian national flag, at the Gachibowli campus in Hyderabad

assets.rightsBasis: Official Manipal University Jaipur logo served from the university's own domain and used as the site-wide header logo on jaipur.manipal.edu. No open licence - used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-09-21: HTTP 200, content-type image/svg+xml, 408,196 bytes, viewBox 456x91 (vector wordmark plus an embedded 282x312 PNG crest). Rendered on a white tile and visually confirmed: orange-and-brown Manipal crest with laurel and 'INSPIRED BY LIFE', dark grey 'MANIPAL UNIVERSITY JAIPUR' serif wordmark - legible. Alternative img/manipal-university-jaipur-logo.svg is near-identical; rasterise the SVG to PNG at upload if the pipeline needs a bitmap.

Wikimedia Commons 'File:Muj.jpg' by Me13farhan, own work, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution and share-alike required: credit 'Me13farhan / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0'). Checked 2026-09-21 with a descriptive User-Agent: HTTP 200, content-type image/jpeg, 720x540. Visually confirmed: aerial view of the Dehmi Kalan campus (domed main building, yellow academic blocks and hostel blocks) in open countryside. CAVEATS: low resolution (720 px wide) and a camera date stamp '14/9/2015 8:52' in the bottom-right corner - crop the bottom ~12% before upload; replace with a higher-resolution rights-safe image when one is found. Official site banners reviewed (img/slider/banner-1.jpg, Website_Home_page_1.jpg, about-us/overview.jpg) were rejected: marketing text overlays or people-only crops with no campus. Other Commons file 'Manipal University Jaipur.jpg' (same author, CC BY-SA 4.0) is 395x395 only. Upload note 2026-09-21: uploaded with a Cloudinary incoming transformation (EXIF rotation, then a 720x460 crop from the top) so the stored cover excludes the camera date stamp; the photo content is unchanged.
assets.altText: Aerial view of the Manipal University Jaipur campus at Dehmi Kalan, with its domed main building and yellow academic and hostel blocks

assets.rightsBasis: Official JMI header logo served from the university's own domain (img alt 'Jamia Millia Islamia Logo' on https://jmi.ac.in/). No open licence - used as the institution's own brand mark for identification only. HTTP 200, content-type image/svg+xml, 8775x1256 viewBox, checked 2026-09-21. Visual check on a white tile: green (#378B66) crescent-and-palm emblem with 'Jamia Millia Islamia' wordmark in Latin, Devanagari and Urdu scripts - fully legible. Rejected: https://jmi.ac.in/Upload/Content/2023-Feb-27-12-26-2-106.svg (white-on-transparent, invisible on white) and https://jmi.ac.in/Upload/Content/2023-Feb-27-12-26-2-105.png (decorative diamond frame, not the pure mark). Wide aspect ratio - rasterise to PNG or pad for square tiles.

Wikimedia Commons 'File:Centenary gate JMI, Delhi.jpg' by Tamjeed Ahmed, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution and share-alike required; credit 'Tamjeed Ahmed, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons'). Direct file URL HTTP 200, content-type image/jpeg, 3556x2667 px, 1.15 MB, checked 2026-09-21 with a descriptive User-Agent. Visual check: red-sandstone Centenary Gate with twin domes and 'Centenary Gate Jamia Millia Islamia' lettering under a clear blue sky; small distant figures only. Alternative: File:Centenary Gate Jamia Millia Islamia.jpg (TheAutumnal, CC BY-SA 4.0, 4000x3000, dusk).
assets.altText: The red-sandstone Centenary Gate of Jamia Millia Islamia in Jamia Nagar, New Delhi, with twin domes and the university's name above the arch

assets.rightsBasis: Official Marwadi University logo served from the university's own WordPress theme and used as the site header logo on marwadiuniversity.ac.in. No open licence - official institutional brand mark used to identify the institution. HTTP 200, content-type image/svg+xml (vector, 226x64 viewBox), checked 2026-09-21. Visual check rendered on a white tile: teal shield with MU monogram, black "Marwadi University" wordmark and "Marwadi Chandarana Group" line - fully legible on white. NOTE: the file includes a gold "NAAC A+" seal on the right; that grade matches the regulator record (NAAC A+, CGPA 3.31, declared 09-11-2023), but crop it out at upload if a pure wordmark is preferred. Rejected: /wp-content/uploads/2025/09/mu-logo.png (260x66 raster that bundles an NIRF logo) and logomain.svg (same NAAC seal variant).

Wikimedia Commons File:Marwadi University.jpg by Eddie Stann, own work, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution and share-alike required: credit "Eddie Stann / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0"). Original 4160x3120 photo dated 24 September 2021 (EXIF); Commons description: PG building at Marwadi University. Direct 1920px rendition checked 2026-09-21 with a descriptive User-Agent: HTTP 200, content-type image/jpeg. Visually confirmed: grey concrete campus building with arched windows beside open lawns and a row of palm trees under an overcast sky, no text overlays. Alternative reviewed: File:Marwadi University..jpg (same author, CC BY-SA 4.0, main-building reflection shot in a puddle - less clear as a hero image).
assets.altText: Postgraduate building and palm-lined lawns on the Marwadi University campus on the Rajkot-Morbi Road, Rajkot, Gujarat

assets.rightsBasis: Official Jamia Hamdard header logo served from the university domain and used as the navbar brand image on https://www.jamiahamdard.ac.in/. No open licence - used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-09-21: HTTP 200, content-type image/png, 52,411 bytes, 622x123 px, fully opaque white background (alpha 255). Visually confirmed on a white tile: green crest with book and crescent plus green JAMIA HAMDARD wordmark and the lines Government Aided Deemed to be University / Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi - 110062 / Accredited with NAAC A+ (consistent with the NAAC register, A+ 3.41, Cycle 4). Wide lockup; crop to the crest if a square mark is needed. The JSON-LD logo (uploads/files/Untitled_design_(35).png) is only 48x48 and was rejected; Wikipedia File:Jamia_Hamdard_Logo.svg is fair-use on enwiki only and was not used.

Official campus photograph on the university domain, used in the homepage campus photo gallery under the Hamdard Convention Centre item. No open licence stated - official institutional image used to identify the institution. Checked 2026-09-21: HTTP 200, content-type image/jpeg, 2,474,108 bytes, 4645x3095 px (landscape). Visual confirmation: arched sandstone facade and clock tower of the Hamdard Convention Centre with signage for the School of Open and Distance Learning, lawns and flagpoles, no text overlay. Wikimedia Commons Category:Jamia_Hamdard holds only event photos (convocations, seminars), and Commons search hits for Hamdard University Karachi/Bangladesh were rejected as different institutions. Alternative official image: https://www.jamiahamdard.ac.in/uploads/files/DSC03640_(1).jpg (Main Academic Building, 6000x4000).
assets.altText: Arched facade and clock tower of the Hamdard Convention Centre on the Jamia Hamdard campus in Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi
